So if you want to get started in the world of real-estate investing, it takes just a few minutes to sign up and create an account with the Fundrise Flagship Fund. 4. Ask This Company to Get a Big Chunk of Debt Forgiven A company named National Debt Relief has the capability to negotiate with lenders to reduce a portion of existing debt. As payments accumulate, negotiations with creditors may lead to a reduction in the total debt owed, which can then be settled in a lump sum. On average, individuals might achieve debt freedom within 24 to 48 months. The sign-up process takes less than a minute to assess potential debt reduction options. 5.
